Subject: Rendale Mercantile Submission

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the Rendale Mercantile submission! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I'll work this up and aim to have indicative terms to you by end of week. The $12.8M total insured value across the four locations is well within our appetite, and the loss history looks clean.

I'll reach out if any questions come up during the quoting process, but we should be in good shape based on what you've provided.

Thanks for thinking of us on this one!

Best,
[Underwriter name]
